DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談予約のことでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about a consultation appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 木曜に生活相談を予約していますが、足をけがして来られなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: けがにより予約来庁が困難と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a daily-life consultation booked for Thursday, but injured my leg and can no longer come.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say an injury makes attending your appointment difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前と予約時刻をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please give your name and appointment time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 田中恵で、木曜十時です。電話で相談する方法に変えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約情報を答え電話相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Megumi Tanaka, Thursday at ten. Can I change to a telephone consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the appointment details and request a telephone consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 電話対応ができる内容か担当に確認します。書類を見ながらのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check whether the topic can be handled by phone. Will you be discussing documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、収入の書類です。見せる必要があれば、事前に送れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認資料の事前送付が可能と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, income documents. If they need to see them, I can send them beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can send the documents in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送付方法も担当が説明します。電話はお一人でお話しになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The coordinator will explain how to send them too. Can you speak on the phone by yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。ただ、聞き取りにくいので、ゆっくり話してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ゆっくりした説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. But I find it hard to hear, so I would like them to speak slowly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a slow explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望も伝えます。変更について本日中の連絡をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that on too. Would you like a response about the change today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。この番号にお願いします。電話相談が難しければ、日程を延期したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 折り返し先と電話不可時の延期希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, at this number, please. If a telephone consultation is difficult, I would like to postpone the appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the callback number and request postponement if phone consultation is unavailable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ確認して折り返します。お電話ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check with the coordinator and call back. Thank you for calling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの書類について何かありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about your discharge documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この封筒は検査結果ですか。来週、別の病院にもかかるので持っていきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査結果の封筒を次の病院へ持参したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does this envelope contain my test results? I am also visiting another hospital next week and want to take it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to take the test-result envelope to the next hospital. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前を確認します。封筒に書かれた宛先は次の病院と同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check your name. Is the addressee on the envelope the same hospital?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前は合っています。宛先も予約した病院です。自分で開けて読んでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名宛先を確認し開封の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The name is right and it is addressed to the hospital I booked. May I open it and read it myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the name and addressee, and ask about opening it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この紹介用の封筒は、開けずに先方へお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please give this referral envelope to the other hospital unopened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分で結果を知りたい場合、別の説明書はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分向けの結果説明資料を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Is there a separate explanation sheet if I want to know the results myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a result explanation document for yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お渡しした説明用の紙はこちらです。内容の質問は担当看護師が伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the explanation sheet we gave you. The nurse in charge can answer questions about it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二枚重なっていて気付きませんでした。この丸の意味を帰る前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明紙を見つけ不明な印を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two sheets were stuck together, so I did not notice it. I want to ask what this circle means before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Find the explanation sheet and ask about an unclear mark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へおつなぎします。紹介用の封筒とは別に持っておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will connect you to the nurse. Keep it separate from the referral envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 封筒は開けずに鞄へ入れます。説明の紙だけ出して、丸の意味を担当に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒と説明紙を分け担当へ質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put the envelope unopened in my bag. I will take out only the explanation sheet and ask the nurse what the circle means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the envelope and explanation sheet and ask the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらでお待ちください。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here. Take care and get well soon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鞄の受け取りに来られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect your bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。連絡をいただきました。私の紺色の鞄ですが、外側のポケットが開いているのが気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発見鞄の受領前に開いたポケットを指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, you contacted me. It is my navy-blue bag, but I am concerned that the outside pocket is open.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the open pocket before accepting the found bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認できる範囲で中身をご覧ください。入れていた物のメモはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the contents as far as you can. Do you have a list of what was inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このメモです。靴はありますが、財布がありません。財布も戻ったと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参一覧と中身を照合し財布不足を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is my list. The shoes are here, but the wallet is not. I came thinking the wallet had been returned too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Compare the list with the contents and say the wallet is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 鞄だけが届けられています。財布の紛失については、担当が状況を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Only the bag was handed in. The coordinator will ask about the lost wallet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 財布のカードは昨日止めました。鞄を受け取っても、財布はまだ見つかっていないと記録されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カード停止済みと未解決財布の記録を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I blocked the wallet's cards yesterday. Even if I collect the bag, will the wallet be recorded as still missing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the cards are blocked and ask about recording the unresolved wallet loss. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その区別を担当と確認しましょう。最後に財布を見た場所もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check that distinction with the coordinator. Please also say where you last saw the wallet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 体育館へ来る前の売店です。鞄に入れたつもりですが、売店の棚へ置いた可能性もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 財布の最終確認と売店置忘れの可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The shop before I came to the gym. I thought I put it in the bag, but may have left it on a shelf there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the last sighting and possibility of leaving the wallet at the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 売店の忘れ物窓口にも問い合わせるとよいですね。受領用紙は鞄についてのものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: It would be good to ask the shop's lost-property counter too. This receipt form concerns the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鞄の受領として署名します。財布の相談は続けて、売店にも今日問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鞄のみ受領し財布相談と売店照会を続ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will sign for the bag. I will continue the wallet consultation and contact the shop today too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept only the bag and continue the wallet consultation and shop inquiry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当へお声掛けください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please speak to the coordinator. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have your missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この荷物を今日ここで受け取りたいです。配達員さんがまだ持っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在荷物の所在と当日窓口受取を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to collect this parcel here today. Does the delivery person still have it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the parcel's location and about collecting it at the counter today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 票の番号を確認します。今日は再配達を申し込まれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the notice number. Have you requested redelivery today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今夜七時に申し込みました。でも外出がなくなり、今すぐ受け取れたらと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 再配達予約と予定変更を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I requested seven tonight. But my outing was canceled, so I hoped to collect it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the redelivery booking and change of plans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在は配達中です。窓口に戻る時刻を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is currently out for delivery. I will ask when it will return to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 再配達と窓口受取りが重ならないよう、申込みを変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重複しない受取方法への変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to change my request so the redelivery and counter collection do not overlap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a change to a collection method without duplication. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ両方の希望を伝えます。すぐ戻るとは限りませんが、お電話で連絡できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the coordinator both requests. It may not return immediately, but we can call you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この携帯へお願いします。荷物が戻るまで、ここで待つ必要はありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先を示し現地待機不要を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please call this mobile. I do not need to wait here until it returns, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give contact details and confirm you need not wait there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。受取りが可能になってからお越しください。本人確認書類もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Come after collection becomes possible, and bring identification too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では一度帰ります。窓口受取りへの変更と、受取可能時刻の連絡をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰宅して受取可能の連絡を待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will go home for now. Please change to counter collection and call with the available collection time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to return home and wait for the collection call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へお伝えします。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the coordinator. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの停止についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about a blocked card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日カードをなくして止めましたが、今朝コートの内ポケットで見つかりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 停止した紛失カードを発見したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost and blocked my card yesterday, but found it in my coat's inside pocket this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report finding the lost card you blocked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停止の受付番号はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the blocking request number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、この番号です。見つかったカードで今日お金を下ろせますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付番号を示し再利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, this number. Can I withdraw money using the found card today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the request number and ask about reuse. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用再開の扱いは停止担当が確認します。すでに再発行もお申し込みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The blocking coordinator will check reactivation. Have you also already requested a replacement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 再発行の用紙はまだ出していません。停止の電話だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再発行は未申請と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not submitted the replacement form. I only called to block it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not applied for a replacement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その状況を伝えます。お急ぎの出金が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell them that. Do you urgently need a withdrawal?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。窓口で下ろす方法があれば知りたいです。通帳と免許証はあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 緊急出金と持参書類を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I would like to know if I can withdraw at the counter. I have my passbook and driver's license.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the urgent withdrawal and documents you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出金担当にも確認します。こちらで本人確認の準備をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also check with the withdrawal coordinator. Please prepare identification here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: カードは使わずに持っておきます。再開の扱いと、窓口での出金を一緒に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: カードを使わず再開と窓口出金を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the card without using it. I will discuss both reactivation and a counter withdrawal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not use the card and discuss reactivation and counter withdrawal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you to the coordinator. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計のことでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この弁当は半額のシールがありますが、レシートでは元の値段でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 値引きが会計へ反映されなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This lunch box has a half-price sticker, but the receipt charged the original price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the discount was not applied at checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品とレシートを拝見します。弁当は二つですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the items and receipt. There are two lunch boxes, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。二つとも半額でした。袋の中のもう一つも出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二商品とも値引き対象と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, both were half price. I will also take the other one out of the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that both items qualify for the discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つのシールを確認しました。担当が会計の記録と照らし合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have checked both stickers. The coordinator will compare them with the checkout record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 支払いは交通系カードです。差額の返金も同じカードになるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カード払いでの差額処理を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I paid with a transit card. Will the difference also be refunded to the same card?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about processing the difference after card payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 処理方法をレジ担当がご案内します。使ったカードをお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The cashier will explain how it is processed. Please have the card you used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここにあります。弁当はまだ温めていませんが、確認に預けたままで大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 支払カードを提示し商品返却を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here it is. I have not heated the lunch boxes yet. Is it all right to leave them with you for checking?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the payment card and discuss return of the items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認は済みましたので、お戻しします。こちらが差額の説明です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The check is finished, so I will return them. Here is the explanation of the difference.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つ分の差額で合っています。担当にカードを見せて、訂正をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つ分の差額を確認し訂正を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The difference for two is correct. I will show the card to the cashier and ask for correction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the difference for both and request correction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらのレジへどうぞ。お知らせいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to this register. Thank you for telling us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 犬を連れてのご利用ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are visiting with a dog, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。犬と一周歩きたいです。この花壇の道にも入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 犬と歩ける区域を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to walk a circuit with my dog. Can we use this flowerbed path too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which areas you can walk with a dog. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 花壇の中の通路は犬をご遠慮いただいています。外周の道は利用できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Dogs are not allowed on the paths inside the flowerbeds. You can use the outer path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外周にします。奥の芝生には、犬を放せる場所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外周を選びリードを外せる区域を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We will take the outer path. Is there an off-leash area on the lawn farther inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the outer path and ask where to remove the leash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この公園には放せる区域はありません。リードを付けたままお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is no off-leash area in this park. Please keep the leash on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。犬が疲れたら、木陰で休める外周の場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 犬の休憩場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. If my dog gets tired, is there a shaded resting spot on the outer path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about a resting place for the dog. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 北側にベンチがあります。そこへ行く途中も歩道から外れずに進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a bench on the north side. You can reach it without leaving the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベンチで少し休みます。飲み水は持っているので、犬用の器を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参の水と器で休ませると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will rest briefly at the bench. I brought drinking water, so I will use the dog's bowl.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will rest using your water and bowl. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ベンチの脇なら通行の妨げになりにくいです。袋もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Beside the bench is less likely to block people. Do you have bags too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、袋があります。外周を北まで歩いて休み、来た道で入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋を持ち経路と折返しを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We will walk north on the outer path, rest, then return to the entrance the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Have bags and decide the route and return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28228-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ楽しいお散歩を。お気をつけて。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符のご購入前にご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question before buying a ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 折りたたみ自転車を持って乗りたいです。このカバーで持ち込めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車カバーの持込条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to board with my folding bicycle. Can I bring it with this cover?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about conditions for bringing a bicycle cover. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車体全体が袋に入っている必要があります。今はタイヤが下から出ていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The whole bicycle must be inside a bag. The tires are sticking out below now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これは雨よけ用でした。タイヤも包める袋を用意すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 全体を収納する袋が必要と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This was a rain cover. Should I prepare a bag that encloses the tires too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm a bag enclosing the whole bicycle is necessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。折りたたんで全体を収納してください。ホームでは押して歩かず、手でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, fold it and enclose the whole thing. On the platform, carry it by hand instead of pushing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日の袋では乗らず、一度家に戻ります。改札前に荷物を確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本日は乗らず再訪時の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not board with today's bag; I will go home first. Can you check the luggage before the ticket gate when I return?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not board today and request checking when you return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 収納した状態でお持ちいただければ、係員が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you bring it enclosed, staff will check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。車内で袋を置く場所も、乗る前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車内の置場も乗車前に相談したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I also want to ask where to put the bag on the train before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to consult about storage on board before boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗る列車の係員にご相談ください。通路や扉の前は空けておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ask the staff of the train you will take. Keep aisles and doorways clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全体が入る袋で出直します。係員の確認を受けてから切符を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 適切な袋を準備し確認後購入と決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will return with a bag that encloses everything. I will buy my ticket after staff check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare a suitable bag and decide to buy after checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: またお待ちしております。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to your return. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about a notice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 健診の案内が前の住所へ届きました。転入の手続きは済んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転入後に旧住所宛て健診通知が届いたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: A health-check notice went to my old address. I already completed moving-in registration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a health-check notice went to the old address after your move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒と案内をご覧いただけますか。発行元はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see the envelope and notice? Who issued it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前に住んでいた市の保健センターです。転送されてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知の発行元と転送経緯を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The health center of my previous city. It was forwarded to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the issuer and how the notice was forwarded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の健診をどこで受けるか、新しい住所の担当にも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check with the office for your new address where you should have this check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受けたいのですが、前の市の券でここでも予約できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧自治体の券の利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to take it. Can I book here using the old city's voucher?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about using the previous municipality's voucher. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる券や対象は保健の担当が確認します。今の住所が分かる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The health office will check eligible vouchers and people. Do you have something showing your current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 免許証の住所は更新しています。通知と一緒に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現住所の本人確認書類を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I updated my license address. I will show it with the notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present identification with the current address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保健担当は二階です。案内の申込期限も伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The health office is on the second floor. Tell them the application deadline too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 締切は来週です。券の扱いと、今の市で予約する方法を二階で聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 期限を伝え券の扱いと予約先を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is next week. I will ask upstairs about the voucher and how to book in my current city.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the deadline and consult about the voucher and booking office. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの階段からどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Use these stairs. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初診の受付はこちらです。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めて来ました。補聴器の電池が切れて、呼び出しの声が聞き取りにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初診時に聞き取り困難を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first visit. My hearing-aid battery is dead, so I cannot hear calls clearly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report difficulty hearing on your first visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付票にそのことを書きます。文字でのご案内は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will note that on the reception form. Can you read written guidance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。名前を呼ぶだけでなく、近くへ来て知らせてもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 読字可能と近くでの呼出しを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It would help if someone came close to notify me instead of only calling my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you can read and request a nearby call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ伝えます。診療科と予約票を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the staff. Let us check the department and appointment slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 耳鼻科で、十時の予約です。予約票はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 科予約時刻と予約票を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: ENT, at ten. Here is the appointment slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the department, time and appointment slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待合室の場所をこの紙に書きます。診察でも文字での説明をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will write the waiting-room location on this paper. Do you also want written explanations in the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。大事な説明は紙に書いてもらいたいです。普通の会話は顔を見てゆっくりお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診察の筆記説明と話し方を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Please write important explanations on paper. For ordinary conversation, please face me and speak slowly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request written consultation explanations and a speaking style. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望も看護師へ引き継ぎます。待つ場所はこちらでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that on to the nurse too. Is this waiting place all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口近くの椅子に座ります。案内の紙を手元に置いて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待機席を決め案内紙を保持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will sit near the entrance. I will wait with the guidance paper at hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a waiting seat and keep the guidance paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 呼び出しの際は担当が伺います。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28229-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff will come to you when calling. Take care.
